environment.description: Lambda function deployed in VPC with ENI in private subnets (10.0.128.0/20, 10.0.144.0/20). Exposed exclusively through an interface VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with endpoint policy restricting Principal to accounts within the AWS Organization (o-abc123def4). The VPC endpoint has private DNS disabled; consumers resolve via vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890-abcdefgh.execute-api.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com. No API Gateway public endpoint exists — the execute-api resource policy contains an explicit Deny for any request where aws:SourceVpce does not match vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. Security group sg-0f1e2d3c4b5a69780 on the VPC endpoint ENIs allows inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.0.0.0/16. No NAT gateway, no internet gateway attached to the VPC. Route tables contain only local routes and the VPC endpoint route.

config.api_gateway: PRIVATE REST API, resource policy with explicit Deny unless aws:SourceVpce=vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890
config.vpc_endpoint: com.amazonaws.execute-api, interface type, private subnets only
config.network: no IGW, no NAT, no public route, private subnets only
config.dns: private DNS disabled, endpoint-specific DNS only
